drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel:
Counsel,

Please find attached our initial draft of the Confidential Settlement Agreement. We have included a bracketed placeholder for the Settlement Amount and added standard provisions regarding timing of payment, mutual confidentiality, authority, governing law, and counterparts for your review.

Best regards,
Aldous Finch LLP

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. The Defendant shall pay the Plaintiff the settlement amount of [SETTLEMENT AMOUNT] within ten (10) business days after the Effective Date by wire transfer pursuant to written instructions provided by Plaintiff’s counsel.
edits.name: Payment clause

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. Upon receipt of the full Settlement Amount, Plaintiff releases Defendant and its respective officers, directors, employees, agents, representatives, insurers, successors, and assigns from all claims asserted or that could have been asserted in the action arising out of the facts alleged therein.
edits.name: Release clause

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The terms of this settlement are strictly confidential and shall not be disclosed by any party except to the parties’ attorneys, accountants, tax advisors, insurers, auditors, or as required by law, court order, or regulation.
edits.name: Confidentiality clause

edits.text: 4. NO ADMISSION. This settlement is a compromise of disputed claims and is not an admission of liability, wrongdoing, or fault by any party, all of which are expressly denied.
edits.name: No admission clause

edits.text: 5. AUTHORITY. Each person signing this Agreement represents that they have full authority to bind the party on whose behalf they sign.
edits.name: Authority clause

edits.text: 6. GOVERNING LAW. This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of [STATE], without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
edits.name: Governing law clause

edits.text: 7. COUNTERPARTS; ELECTRONIC SIGNATURES. This Agreement may be executed in counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original, and signatures transmitted electronically shall be deemed effective as originals.
edits.name: Counterparts clause
